notes: Every source and target id is partitioned once; 11 source ids and 14 target ids all accounted for.
The beatitude frame is divided as in verse 8: the copula with אַשְׁרֵי and the supplied antecedent pronoun with the written שֶׁ under rule 46's first rider.
עֹלָלַיִךְ → *thy little ones* heads on *little* under rule 31, *ones* alone naming nothing; the competing head *ones* is recorded in the unit note.
